name: toss
description: Send files to your own devices and friends, peer to peer and end-to-end encrypted.
long_description:
toss sends files straight between devices: no accounts, no cloud storage, end-to-end encrypted with a post-quantum key exchange. With this extension Claude can list your paired devices and send them files, and nothing else: pairing, removing devices and settings stay with you.

Pair your devices first with the toss app ([download](https://github.com/plamen-g/toss/releases)). Someone on the other device still accepts each transfer, unless it takes files from yours without asking.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the devices paired with toss.

tools.name: send_files
tools.description: Send files or folders to a paired device, end-to-end encrypted.
